content: Mobile demo embedding on web has two distinct approaches: (1) device-frame mockup components (react-device-mockup, react-device-frame) that wrap a rendered React/react-native-web component in an iPhone/Android chrome purely for visual framing — no native runtime involved; (2) true react-native-web compilation of shared RN components to run in-browser for higher fidelity. WebView/iframe embedding is for showing external web content inside native apps, the opposite direction, not applicable here.
